🔴 What Doctors Are Saying
Prof. Suryakant (KGMU) warns:
HMPV is serious for kids & elderly.
Symptoms may appear mild, but in some cases, it leads to oxygen support.
Be vigilant and consult a doctor immediately if symptoms worsen.

🔴 Do’s & Don’ts to Stay Safe

✅ Do’s:
🧼 Wash hands frequently
😷 Wear a mask in public
💧 Stay hydrated
🏥 Consult a doctor if unwell

❌ Don’ts:
🚫 Don’t ignore cough or fever
🚫 Don’t visit crowded places unnecessarily
🚫 Don’t self-medicate
